PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?cap ?label WHERE {
  ?org sdk:hasProcessCapability ?cap .
  ?cap rdfs:label ?label .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?label)), "machining"))
}

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX iof-scro: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/supplychain/SupplyChain/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX bfo: <http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/>

SELECT DISTINCT ?materialCapability ?label ?type WHERE {
  ?org sdk:hasMaterialCapability ?materialCapability .
  ?materialCapability rdfs:label ?label .
  OPTIONAL { ?materialCapability a ?type . }
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?label)), "steel"))
}

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX iof-scro: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/supplychain/SupplyChain/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX bfo: <http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/>

SELECT ?latitude WHERE {
  ?site a sdk:GeospatialLocation ;
        sdk:locatedInCity ?city ;
        sdk:hasSpatialCoordinates ?coords .
  ?city rdfs:label ?cityName .
  ?coords sdk:hasLatitudeValue ?latitude .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?cityName)), "springfield"))
}

PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX iof-scro: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/supplychain/SupplyChain/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX bfo: <http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/>

SELECT ?company ?name ?latitude ?longitude WHERE {
  ?company rdfs:label ?name .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?name)), "surface finish")) .
  ?company sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  ?site sdk:hasSpatialCoordinates ?coords .
  ?coords sdk:hasLatitudeValue ?latitude ;
          sdk:hasLongitudeValue ?longitude .
}

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?industry ?industryLabel (COUNT(DISTINCT ?manufacturer) AS ?manufacturerCount)
WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
                sdk:suppliesToIndustry ?industry .
  ?industry rdfs:label ?industryLabel .
}
GROUP BY ?industry ?industryLabel
ORDER BY DESC(?manufacturerCount)

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX iof-scro: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/supplychain/SupplyChain/>

SELECT ?state ?stateLabel (AVG(?numVal) AS ?avgNumberOfEmployees)
WHERE {
  ?m a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
     sdk:hasNumberOfEmployees ?numRaw ;
     sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  ?site sdk:locatedInCity ?city .
  ?city sdk:locatedInState ?state .
  OPTIONAL { ?state rdfs:label ?stateLabel. }
  BIND(xsd:decimal(REPLACE(str(?numRaw), ",", "")) AS ?numVal)
}
GROUP BY ?state ?stateLabel
ORDER BY ?stateLabel

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?stateLabel (SUM(xsd:integer(?num)) AS ?totalEmployees)
WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer .
  ?manufacturer sdk:hasNumberOfEmployees ?num .
  ?manufacturer sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  ?site sdk:locatedInCity ?city .
  ?city sdk:locatedInState ?state .
  ?state rdfs:label ?stateLabel .
}
GROUP BY ?stateLabel
ORDER BY ?stateLabel

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX iof-scro: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/supplychain/SupplyChain/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX bfo: <http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/>

SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?manufacturer) AS ?countWithoutDescription)
WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer .
  FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?manufacturer iof-core:describedBy ?desc . }
}

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

ASK {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
                sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  ?site sdk:locatedInCity ?city .
  ?city sdk:locatedInState ?state .
  ?state rdfs:label ?stateLabel .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?stateLabel)), "texas"))
}

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?manufacturer ?manufacturerLabel WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer .
  ?manufacturer sdk:suppliesToIndustry ?ind1 .
  ?manufacturer sdk:suppliesToIndustry ?ind2 .
  ?ind1 a sdk:RenewableEnergyIndustry .
  ?ind2 a sdk:UtilitiesIndustry .
  OPTIONAL { ?manufacturer rdfs:label ?manufacturerLabel }
}

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?manufacturer ?state ?stateLabel
WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
                sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  ?site sdk:locatedInCity ?city .
  ?city sdk:locatedInState ?state .
  ?state rdfs:label ?stateLabel .
  FILTER(regex(str(?stateLabel), "^New "))
}

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX iof-scro: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/supplychain/SupplyChain/>

SELECT ?manufacturer ?manufacturerLabel ?employees WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
                sdk:hasNumberOfEmployees ?employees ;
                sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  ?site sdk:locatedInCity ?city .
  ?city sdk:locatedInState ?state .
  ?state rdfs:label ?stateLabel .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?stateLabel)), "ohio"))
  OPTIONAL { ?manufacturer rdfs:label ?manufacturerLabel }
  BIND(xsd:integer(REPLACE(STR(?employees), ",", "")) AS ?empInt)
}
ORDER BY ASC(?empInt)
LIMIT 1

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?state ?stateLabel (COUNT(DISTINCT ?manufacturer) AS ?numManufacturers)
WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
                sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  ?site sdk:locatedInCity ?city .
  ?city sdk:locatedInState ?state .
  OPTIONAL { ?state rdfs:label ?stateLabel }
}
GROUP BY ?state ?stateLabel
ORDER BY DESC(?numManufacturers)
LIMIT 1

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX iof-scro: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/supplychain/SupplyChain/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?manufacturer ?manufacturerLabel ?lat WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
                sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  ?site sdk:hasSpatialCoordinates ?coords .
  ?coords sdk:hasLatitudeValue ?lat .
  OPTIONAL { ?manufacturer rdfs:label ?manufacturerLabel . }
}
ORDER BY DESC(xsd:float(?lat))
LIMIT 1

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX iof-scro: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/supplychain/SupplyChain/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX bfo: <http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/>

SELECT ?manufacturer ?zip
WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer .
  OPTIONAL {
    ?manufacturer sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?loc .
    ?loc sdk:hasZIPcode ?zipNode .
    ?zipNode sdk:hasIntegerValue ?zip .
  }
}

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?manufacturer ?manufacturerLabel (GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ?capName; separator=", ") AS ?capabilities)
WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer .
  OPTIONAL { ?manufacturer rdfs:label ?manufacturerLabel . }
  ?manufacturer (sdk:hasProcessCapability|sdk:hasMaterialCapability) ?cap .
  ?cap rdfs:label ?capName .
}
GROUP BY ?manufacturer ?manufacturerLabel
ORDER BY ?manufacturerLabel

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?state ?stateLabel (COUNT(DISTINCT ?manufacturer) AS ?manufacturerCount)
WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
                sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  ?site sdk:locatedInCity ?city .
  ?city sdk:locatedInState ?state .
  ?state a sdk:State ;
         rdfs:label ?stateLabel .
}
GROUP BY ?state ?stateLabel
ORDER BY DESC(?manufacturerCount)

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?state ?stateLabel (COUNT(DISTINCT ?man) AS ?numManufacturers)
WHERE {
  ?man a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
       sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  ?site sdk:locatedInCity ?city .
  ?city sdk:locatedInState ?state .
  ?state a sdk:State .
  OPTIONAL { ?state rdfs:label ?stateLabel . }
}
GROUP BY ?state ?stateLabel
ORDER BY DESC(?numManufacturers)
LIMIT 1

PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?bucket (COUNT(?company) AS ?companyCount)
WHERE {
  ?company a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
           sdk:hasNumberOfEmployees ?employees .
  BIND(xsd:integer(REPLACE(STR(?employees), ",", "")) AS ?empInt)
  FILTER(?empInt > 250)
  BIND(
    IF(?empInt <= 500, "251-500",
      IF(?empInt <= 1000, "501-1000", ">1000")
    ) AS ?bucket
  )
}
GROUP BY ?bucket
ORDER BY ?bucket

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?stateLabel (AVG(xsd:decimal(REPLACE(str(?numEmployees), ",", ""))) AS ?avgEmployees)
WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
                sdk:manufactures ?product ;
                sdk:hasNumberOfEmployees ?numEmployees ;
                sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  ?product rdfs:label ?productLabel .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(?productLabel), "pipe"))
  ?site sdk:locatedInCity ?city .
  ?city sdk:locatedInState ?state .
  ?state rdfs:label ?stateLabel .
}
GROUP BY ?stateLabel

PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>

SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?manufacturer) AS ?count)
WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
                sdk:hasProcessCapability ?cap .
  ?cap a ?capType .
  ?capType rdfs:subClassOf* sdk:SurfaceFinishingCapability .
}

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?manufacturer ?manufacturerLabel WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer .
  ?manufacturer sdk:hasMaterialCapability ?steelCap .
  ?steelCap a sdk:SteelProcessingCapability .
  ?manufacturer sdk:hasMaterialCapability ?bronzeCap .
  ?bronzeCap a sdk:BronzeProcessingCapability .
  OPTIONAL { ?manufacturer rdfs:label ?manufacturerLabel }
}

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX iof-scro: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/supplychain/SupplyChain/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX bfo: <http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/>

SELECT ?industry ?industryLabel (COUNT(DISTINCT ?org) AS ?supplierCount)
WHERE {
  ?org a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
       sdk:suppliesToIndustry ?industry ;
       sdk:manufactures ?prod .
  ?prod rdfs:label ?prodLabel .
  ?industry rdfs:label ?industryLabel .
  FILTER(CONTAINS(LCASE(STR(?prodLabel)), "pipe"))
}
GROUP BY ?industry ?industryLabel
HAVING (COUNT(DISTINCT ?org) > 100)

PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?cityLabel (AVG(?empNum) AS ?averageEmployeeCount)
WHERE {
  ?m a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
     sdk:hasProcessCapability ?cap ;
     sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site ;
     sdk:hasNumberOfEmployees ?empVal .
  ?cap a sdk:HeatTreatingCapability .
  ?site sdk:locatedInCity ?city .
  ?city rdfs:label ?cityLabel .
  BIND(xsd:decimal(?empVal) AS ?empNum)
}
GROUP BY ?cityLabel
ORDER BY ?cityLabel

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX iof-scro: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/supplychain/SupplyChain/>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
PREFIX bfo: <http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/>

SELECT ?manufacturer ?label ?text
WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
                iof-core:describedBy ?desc .
  ?desc iof-scro:hasTextValue ?text .
  OPTIONAL { ?manufacturer rdfs:label ?label }
  FILTER(STRLEN(STR(?text)) > 20)
}

PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX iof-scro: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/supplychain/SupplyChain/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?company ?label
WHERE {
  ?company sdk:suppliesToIndustry ?ind .
  ?ind a ?type .
  OPTIONAL { ?company rdfs:label ?label. }
  FILTER (?type IN (sdk:RenewableEnergyIndustry, sdk:UtilitiesIndustry))
}
GROUP BY ?company ?label
HAVING (
  COUNT(DISTINCT ?ind) = 2
  && SUM(IF(?type = sdk:RenewableEnergyIndustry, 1, 0)) >= 1
  && SUM(IF(?type = sdk:UtilitiesIndustry, 1, 0)) >= 1
)
LIMIT 2

PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?manufacturer ?manufacturerLabel WHERE {
  ?manufacturer a iof-core:Manufacturer .
  ?manufacturer sdk:hasCertificate ?cert1 .
  ?manufacturer sdk:hasCertificate ?cert2 .
  ?cert1 a sdk:ISO9001 .
  ?cert2 a sdk:ISO14001 .
  OPTIONAL { ?manufacturer rdfs:label ?manufacturerLabel. }
}

PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
SELECT ?naicsCodeValue (COUNT(?man) AS ?numManufacturers)
WHERE {
  ?man a iof-core:Manufacturer ;
       sdk:hasPrimaryNAICSClassifier ?naicsInst .
  ?naicsInst sdk:hasNAICSCodeValue ?naicsCodeValue .
}
GROUP BY ?naicsCodeValue
ORDER BY DESC(?numManufacturers)
LIMIT 1

PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT ?company ?site ?city ?state ?stateName WHERE {
  ?company a iof-core:Manufacturer .
  ?company sdk:organizationLocatedIn ?site .
  ?site sdk:locatedInCity ?city .
  ?city sdk:locatedInState ?state .
  ?state rdfs:label ?stateName .
}

PREFIX sdk: <http://asu.edu/semantics/SUDOKN/>
PREFIX iof-core: <https://spec.industrialontologies.org/ontology/core/Core/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?manufacturer ?label ?zip ?lat
WHERE {
  FILTER(false)
}
